title: Russian intelligence sends an armed team to protect CIA officers during the 1993 coup attempt against Yeltsin

tellings.quote: He said, "Okay, Ralph, here's some very extraordinary circumstances. We're going to send you a team of heavily armed guys to try to keep you from getting captured.

plain: Rolf Mowatt-Larssen, a former officer of the CIA, the US foreign intelligence agency, tells podcast host Jesse Michels about 1993, when people tried to overthrow Russia's president Boris Yeltsin. He says that while he was at the US ambassador's residence in Moscow, a Russian intelligence contact told him, "We're going to send you a team of heavily armed guys to try to keep you from getting captured." The story stands out because it would mean rival spy services protected each other in a crisis.
